tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen nag po lugs kyi sgrub dkyil gnyis lhan cig bsdebs pa gsar bu'i blo can 'jug bde kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na moḥshrī wan saṅgu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza tsakra sam+ba ra ye/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /mdzad pa'i bde mchog sgrub dkyil gnyis/ /lhan cig bsdebs te 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga'i gsal byed phyag len gyi rim pa cung zad brjod na/ de la don bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs kyi rim pa dang / mjug gi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa la sogs pa ste/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog tu blta'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa la/ sa chog sta gon/ thig gi bri ba/ tshon gyi bri ba/ bskyed cing byin gyis brlab pa/ mchod pa/ 'jug pa dang bdun gyi dang po sa chog dgos pa'i phyogs la dkyil chog bzhin bya'o// ༈ //gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ sa chog byas na sta gon dkyil chog bzhin bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa la sogs par sa chog mi dgos pas/ de la sta gon ni/ gnas khang phyag dar dang gtsang sbras thon par byas shing / yid du 'ong ba der bla bre dang yol bas brgyan/ yi dam chos skyongs sogs kyi bris sku dgram/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'og nas 'byung ba ltar las thig gi cha dbye ba'i steng du 'god sngags dang mthun par 'bras la sogs pas tshom bu bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang / byang las kyi rdo rjes dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang /

gzhan rnams la zlum por byas pa'i steng du/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu gcig rnams bkod/ de nas rgyas par na lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa byed/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor de'i mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho/ 'jig rten pa'i lho nub tu mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog de nas g.yon skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga phyogs mtshams re rer bkod pas/ zhal zas 'jig rten pa'i nub drang por yong ba spyi mchod/ sgos mchod ni/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas gsum tshan pa re re byas pas g.yon skor du 'dod snam gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshan pa re re bkod pa/ bde chen 'khor lo nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i bar gyi sgos mchod/ de'i nang dkyil 'khor gyi shar nub tu tshan pa re bshams pa gtso bo yab yum ste sgos mchod bsdus pa'i lugs dang / dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ma'i dus sta gon gyi skabs 'dir sgos mchod rgyas pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa drug cu rtsa gnyis phyag len la mdzad pas/ de'i bshom lugs ni/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi tshom bu'i phyi nas bzung / gtso 'khor rnams yab yum so sor 'bul ba'i shar nub kyi tshangs thig steng la g.yon skor du spos mar me zhal zas gsum tshar dgu dgu bshams pa shar du gtso bo yab yum nas brtsams sgo ma'i bar gyi'o/ /lho byang gnyis kyi tshangs thig steng la gsum tshan brgyad brgyad bshams pa lā mā dang / gzugs can ma nas sgo ma'i bar gyi'o/ /mtshams bzhi'i zur thig steng la gsum tshan bdun bdun bshams pa/ thugs 'khor ba'i mtshams bzhi nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i gshin rje bstan ma sogs mtshams ma bzhi'i bar gyi'o/ /de ltar bkod pas drug cu rtsa gnyis tshang / sa lho'i tshom bu'i mdun du tshan pa gcig dang / gtor chung gcig rnams bshams pa'o/ /gzhan 'das gtor dang chos skyong gi gtor ma la sogs pa rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/

mchod gtor de dag kyang rgyu bzang zhing / sbyor ba gtsang sbra che ba/ bkod pa mdzes pa/ phyag len phra mo tshun chad ma nyams par bshams/ gzhan yang rol mo'i tshogs dang 'og tu dgos pa'i phur pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga rin po che la sogs pa'i snod 'brus bkang pa la go rim ma 'khrugs par btsugs pa dang / gos zung / ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ slob ma sta gon dgos na de dag gi chas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bum gdan la rnam rgyal g.yon/ las bum g.yas/ ḍā ma ru/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'dus byas la/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bi d+ye ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing / phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ/ tṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+ma na/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai wam/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ pi ba tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+ya/ sat+pu khaṃ/ bi shud+dha/ sa hā ya ka bha ban+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/

ar+ghaṃnas shap+da'i bar gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing srin lag gis nang mchod kyang dbul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' bsdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang /

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba sogs skabs dang sbyar/ 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung zhing / dngos grub sgrub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma phyi rol tu dor ro/ /de nas lag pa gnyis mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal te/ gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes pa dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi kā pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang / oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra mi tā/ nā da swa bha we na badz+ra dhar+m+ma hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ tshar gsum gyi dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyi gnas khang byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil chog las/ maṇ+ḍal phul la lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la/ zhes 'byung bas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bya ste/ de'i tshul brjod na/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma dbul/ de yang / oṃ badz+ra bhu mi a hūm̐ nas lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang 'dir 'dus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal te/ ting phor nas kyis bkang la ring bu btsugs pa slob dpon gyi mdun du phul/ gzhan der 'dus pa rnams la me tog bkram mo/ /yang phyag gsum btsal la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo snying khar sbyar la gral gyi mthar langs te/ ngag tu/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang /

/yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ /me tog gtor/ de 'dra ba lan gsum tshar ba dang / phyag gsum btsal nas/ slob dpon ma yin pa gzhan tshogs pa rnams la me tog bsdus/ yang phyag gsum btsal nas/ thams cad kyis thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs gong bzhin brjod la slob dpon gyis phyag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyi tshom bu kha gsos te/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud la rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes pa brtan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing reng bu maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su btsugs/ mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor gyi drung gang bder phul nas bzhag la/ slar phyag gsum btsal te gral la 'khod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ zhes bskul te/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang / dkyil 'khor bsdus nas rang gtso bo yab yum phyag bcu gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa la go cha gsum gyis bsrung ba'i bar/ sa lo tsā ba chen pos mdzad pa'i nag po pa'i sgrub thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer bzhin bya dgos pas/ de la sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po la gnyis/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/

skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshad med bsgom pa/ sems bskyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so/ /dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du/ mos la/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ sems kyi gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo/

/gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ rang gi zhal bzhi las/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer spros/ sems can thams cad tshad med bzhi la bkod par bsams la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur/ sogs spyi ltar ro/ /rje sa chen gyis tshad med bzhi 'dir mi bya zhes pa'i don/ lū hi pa ltar sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pa 'dir mi bya zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi sku ru gyur pa yi/ /bdag ni he ru kar byas nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la dgod par bya/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi bab/ yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi pad+mar babs yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas bzhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang /

rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa badz+ra he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la bzhi/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /don de dang ldan pa bdag nyid do/ /rang gi snying khar ā dkar po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ rang gi sems gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i hūm̐ du gsal ba'i zhabs kyu bya ba sgrub pa/ khog pa so sor rtogs pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos dbyings ye shes te/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

rang nyid he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ 'od zer phyir spros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyis steng gi cha la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyis nam mkhar phaiṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā re bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhuṣ+paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ phyi mchod do/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtogs/ yang sngar gyi phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bit+pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ a brta ya hoḥ na mas+sa mān+ta/ bud+dhā nan/ a bi sma ye/ sa pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ/ ga ga na/ khaṃ/ dharmā dhā tu ā kā sha sa mān+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ par+ṣadha la/ maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dha na/ pu ṇ+ya/ dzñā na/ ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ banra ni/ swas+d+ya/ ba le na tsa swāhā/

phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtog go /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa spyi 'gro lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ gsum pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sems de yang rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul gyi sprul pa'i nam mkhar nā da/ thig le/ zla tshes/ mgo bo/ khog pa/ zhabs kyu hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'og tu paṃ raṃ hūm̐ rnams chad de/ pad+ma nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las steng dang shar du khwa gdong ma re re/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma re re/ lhor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams spros nas bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad/ lus kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub se gol phyogs g.yon skor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du bstan cing / ngag tu/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga bān bi d+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i dra ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+ri bhā wa ban+dha hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa rā dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ phyag rgya snga ma phyogs kun tu ston cing / sngags rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum re brjod/ slar yang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang / tho ba'i tshogs spros nas pho nya rnams kyi phyag tu gtad cing / pho nya rnams las kyang rang 'dra'i sprul pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag med spros te/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bkug dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pas phur bu brdung ba'i tshul bya zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro ādzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ pho nya rnams rdo rje rwa ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas sgrub pa po sangs rgyas kyi bar bsrung bar mdzad do/ /sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gnyis/ tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang / lha'i snang ba'ang ye shes su shes par bya ba'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/

laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu/ raṃ las me/ yaṃ las rlung / de'i steng du/ suṃ las ri rab/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams dang rang gi sems snang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po waṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ bh+rum̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du sngon po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba'i steng du/ rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang / de'i steng du rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byed pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang /

gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas la/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa sman dang / bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gar bu sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng du mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhir gnas pa'i/ phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ bar ma gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ lte ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing gsal la sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'phro ba lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun po thams cad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan/ 'khor gyis gnas thams cad du ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du drag gtum/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ byang shar du hā hā rgod pa'i dur khrod/ rim pa de bzhin du/ brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/

chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad dang / shir sha a shat+tha/ kaṃ ka la/ tsū ta/ ka rañdza/ lā ta parka ti/ parti pa ṭa/ bha ṭa ste shing brgyad dang / de rnams kyi yal ga'i gseb tu sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad dang / sgra grags pa/ smugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad dang / nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ pad+ma/ hu lun+ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / pad+ma chen po ste klu brgyad dang / gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'o// //spyi don gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la gnyis las/ dang po/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i 'phreng ba lta bu'i a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i 'phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la ba ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug dkar po hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo/

bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po 'od dmar zhing 'jigs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas sngo/ nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal gdab/ yum dmar mo yin no/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ dang / bu gar byaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' ā las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze 'bru la ā dang / bu khar dh+yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sngar gyi bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo bar snang na gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar thig le'i rnam par babs pas/ yab yum gnyis bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ byang chub sems kyi thig ler gyur// //gnyis pa 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /dang po la bzhi ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ bsnyen pa/ go cha dgod pa/ nye bar bsgrub pa/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bsgrub pa/ dbang bskur bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta satwaṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ zhes mgrin gcig tu bskul bas thig le de cha gnyis su gyur/ de las hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/

phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas bzung bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ drug pa na gri gug g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga bzhi pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lnga pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches spras shing / g.yon phyogs na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / mtshog ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lto ba dang / skye gnas brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje'i rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhal bzhi la dmigs nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsa zhal/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yon zhal/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

rgyab zhal/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān bi d+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yas zhal lo/ /sku bying la dmigs nas/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /gnyis pa nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ yab yum gnyis ka'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hūm̐ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭ haṃ ljang khu rta mchog dang / yum gyi lte bar oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo ste yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral bar oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swāhā dkar po sku rdo rje/ yum gyi thugs kar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra b.raṇ+ṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ badz+ra tsau ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral bar oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ dkar po sku rdo rje/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par ā dmar po 'od dpag med/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ lte bar swa ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/

gsang gnas su hā ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing / rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor bdag dang chos thams cad rnam par dag tshar gcig bzhi pa bsgrub pa chen po ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang / yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur rgyan/ re re'i mgor mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da'i bar dang / snying po gnyis kyi mtha' 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi/ bha gar dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ dkyil 'khor spros te nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa/ pho nya rnam gsum bsres nas byin gyis brlabs pa/ go cha dgod cing byin gyis brlabs pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ yab yum gyi mkha' gsang sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ dga' ba'i sgra dang / snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/

phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs/ yab kyi thig le dang yum gyi rak+ta ro gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan/ phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi thig le bcom ldan 'das yab yum/ gzhan rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thod pa thugs gsung sku'i lha sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams su gyur// //gnyis pa dkyil 'khor spros te nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab pa la gnyis/ gzhi 'god pa dang / spro ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis brtseg tu gnas pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ nang skor gyi phyogs bzhir g.yon skor du laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi/ phyi skor 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su khams dang bcas rtsa rnams/ pu/ dza/ au/ a/ gor/ de/ ma/ ka o/ tri/ ko ka la/ ka hi/ pre/ gṛ/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku'i rnam pa can no/ /gnyis pa spro ba dngos ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/ 'og rlung bskyod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha'i rnam par shes pa'i rten khams dpa' bo hūm̐ gi rnam par gnas pa la thim pas nang gi he ru kar gyur pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar 'bras bu rdor 'dzin ltar gsal gdab/ mkha' nang nas drangs pa phyir spros te phyi'i he ru ka la thim/

mkha' nang gi rdo rje phag mo rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ rang gi lte ba'i aṃ la reg pas byin brlabs/ yar drangs snying kha'i phyi shun gyi rtsa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can la thim pas nang gi he ru ka'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yar drangs pa phyir spros nas phyi'i yum la thim/ mkha' nang gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha'i nang skor gyi phyogs kyi 'dab ma'i yig 'bru rnams la reg pas nang gi rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur/ yar byon pa rnams phyir spros nas phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir 'khod pa ni nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i tshul dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i nang du glang po che dang / ce spyang dang / mi dang / ba lang rnams 'dzin pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha'i mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi la reg yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir 'khod pa ni/ nang dang phyi'i mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams rim pa bzhin rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas so sor reg pas gnas rnams yul dang / khams rnams dpa' bo dang / rtsa rnams rnal 'byor ma rnams su gyur/

yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros gzhal yas khang gi gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ nang gi spyi bo'i so dang sen mo'i khams dang / rtsa pu'i rnam pa can dang / phyi'i thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs/ pu li ra ma la yar/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug gi sku dang ba spu'i khams dang / rtsa dza'i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs dza lan dha rar mahā kaṅka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas su lpags pa dang dri ma'i khams dang / rtsa o'i rnam pa can dang / nub rtsibs au ḍi ya nar kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag par sha'i khams dang rtsa a'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon par chu rgyus kyi khams dang rtsa go'i rnam pa can dang / shar lho'i rtsibs go da ba rir su ra bī ra dang dpa' ba'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus su rus pa'i khams dang rtsa ra'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs ra me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis su mchin pa'i khams dang rtsa da'i rnam pa can dang / nub byang gi rtsibs de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis su snying gi khams dang rtsa ma'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ mchan khung gnyis su mig gi khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma rū par aṅgu ri dang / ai ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis su mkhris pa'i khams dang rtsa o'i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte bar glo ba'i khams dang rtsa tri'i rnam pa dang / nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/

sna rtser rgyu ma'i khams dang rtsa ko'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / khar snye ma'i khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / shar lho'i rtsibs ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de bī/ mgrin par lto ba'i khams dang rtsa la'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs lam+ba kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste ts+tshan+do ha/ snying khar dri chen gyi khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / nub byang gi rtsibs kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'doms bar du mtshogs ma'i khams dang rtsa hi'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste nye ba'i ts+tshan+do hā ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /mtshan mar bad kan gyi khams dang rtsa pre'i rnam pa can dang / sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam du rnag gi khams dang rtsa gṛ'i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis su khrag gi khams dang rtsa sau'i rnam pa can dang / nub rtsibs sau raṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa gnyis su rngul gyi khams dang / rtsa su'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs su bar+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug tu tshil gyi khams dang rtsa na'i rnam pa can dang / shar lho'i rtsibs na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su mchi ma'i khams dang / rtsa si'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhir mchil ma'i khams dang rtsa ma'i rnam pa can dang /

nub byang gi rtsibs ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su snabs kyi khams dang tsa ku'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud cing / gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi hūm̐ la reg pas nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur/ yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros te phyi'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod pa ni/ nang dang phyi'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ shar sgor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i brgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ drag mo shin tu khros pa'i tshul can/ nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so so rnams su reg pas spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re kha/ sna rin chen pha gu/ so dra ba dra phyed/ lce mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi bu ga dgu ni dur khrod brgyad rnams su gyur yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros nas phyi'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ gsum pa pho nya rnam gsum bsres nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag gi bsgom pa'i sngags skyes phyi nang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid ni phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams yin la/

de yang 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams yin zhing / de thams cad dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin no/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bi ra yo gi ni kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ bdag gi bsgom pa'i sngags skyes kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi zhing skyes dang / 'og min gyi lhan skyes rnams dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa nga'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ bzhi pa go cha dgod cing byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ go cha gnyis gong bzhin dgod do/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la bzhi ste/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa/ phyi dang nang gi mchod pas mchod cing bstod pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag dran pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong tshogs zhing ltar phyi dang yid byung gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor chos thams cad rnam par dag la/ bdag kyang de'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing / lag pas pad skor 'khyud rgya gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin phyi dang yid byung gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/

dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ shrī tsakrā bī ra satwaṃ/ kā kā s+ye/ ū lū kā s+ye/ shwa nā s+ye/ su kā ra s+ye/ ya ma dā dhi ye/ ya ma du tī ye/ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭī ṇ+ye/ ya ma ma thā nī ye/ badz+ri bhā ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing phyi nang gi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ lā ma la don yod grub pa/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gzhan 'khor lo bzhi'i shar phyogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ byang phyogs pa rnams la don yod grub pa/ nub phyogs pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ lho phyogs pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ shar lho ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ lho nub pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub byang ba rnams la 'od dpag med/ byang shar ba rnams la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ gsum pa phyi nang gi mchod bstod bya ba la drug sngags mchod/ phyi/ nang / gsang ba/ yid byung / bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ go cha gnyis rnams 'og bzlas pa'i skabs ltar la/ ma mo bcu gnyis la spel med par tshar re re bzla'o/ /gnyis pa phyi mchod ni/ mchod rdzas dngos su bshams pa'am/ yid kyis bsams nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi kā pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/

pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang po sprul nas lha thams cad la mchod pa phul bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin gzhan rnams la yang sbyar nas 'bul lo/ /gsum pa nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su yod dam/ med na bsam ste/ 'og gtor ma'i skabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ lag g.yon mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du chos 'byung bri zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na/ yab yum gyi snying po/ nye snying / 'khor rnams kyi sngags 'phreng ltar ram/ bsdu na/ hūm̐ baṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ pu dza/ sogs dang / hūm̐ brgyad/ go cha gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lnga dang lag pas rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /bzhi pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ lha thams cad snyoms par bzhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā bā at+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa yid mchod ni gong ltar bya'o/ /drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i skabs bzhin bya ste/ mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag dran pa ni/ rgyas pa byed na/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'o/

/sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni mahā kaṅka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ dad pa'i dbang po ni su rā bī ra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po ni rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni aṅku ri dang ai ra ba ti/ dad pa'i stobs ni rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de bī/ shes rab kyi stobs ni rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni mig mi bzang dang kha ga na/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi nī/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/

yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma/ dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes brjod/ bsdu na/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i phyi nang gi lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag go /rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa 'dis chog cing / skabs su rgyas pa bya'o/ /bskyed rim la sems 'dzin na gtso bo'i spyi gtsug gi nor bu dang / zhabs kyi sen mo res 'jog tu byed do/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan zin to// //spyi don gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ ba san+ta tī la ka ltar na/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer spros pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gi bsgom pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gi lus dkyil gyi gnas so so rnams su thim/ bcud kyi sems can 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam par byas pa rnams 'od du zhu ba 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba/ rlung dang bstun nas khwa gdong ma nas mkha' 'gro ma'i bar shar phyogs pa rnams rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ 'ug gdong ma nas lā ma'i bar byang phyogs pa rnams sna bug g.yas nas thim/ khyi gdong ma nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'i bar nub phyogs pa rnams g.yon nas༞

phag gdong ma nas gzugs can ma'i bar lho phyogs pa rnams g.yas nas༞ gshin rje brtan ma nas mtshams kyi thod pa'i bar shar lho ba rnams g.yon nas༞ de bzhin du/ lho nub pa rnams g.yas nas༞ nub byang pa rnams g.yon nas༞ byang shar ba rnams g.yas nas thim/ yum yang 'od dmar por zhu nas lte ba'i aṃ la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim pas/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i snying khar hūm̐ sngo skya/ lte bar aṃ dmar po shad kyi rnam pa can la cung zad sems gtad/ de rjes rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ lte ba nas snying kha'i bar la rtsa a wa dhū ti kha dog dmar skya drang zhing gsal ba/ g.yas su rā sa na dmar po me'i rang bzhin/ g.yon du lā la na dkar po chu'i rang bzhin/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su oṃ/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la/ a/ ka tsa/ ṭa/ ta/ pa/ ya/ sha phyi skor lnga bcu rtsa drug la yi ge med pa/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐/ 'dab ma brgyad la phyogs bzhir bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ sum mdor me/ gshang sgor rlung / 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas/ tha ma la bsdams pas gshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar bas lte ba'i aṃ 'bar me lce g.yas ro ma nas song / snying kha'i hūm̐ la phog pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems dkar po g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ oṃ la phog pas me sbar bas cher 'bar ba dbu ma nas yar song hūm̐ la phog yang de las byang sems dkar po cher babs pa/ dbu ma nas thur du song ba lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam nas 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad/ cing 'dir rlung lan gcig bus la yun ring 'dzin/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin no/ /de lta bu'i rlung sbyor gsum tsam ci rigs byas rjes rig pa stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu la mnyam par bzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste lam gyi dngos gzhi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bstan zin to//

//gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying kha nas rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par spros te sngar bzhin gsal bar gnas pa'i rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng byung / zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal nas zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ pad+ma nas rang gi gsang gnas nas byung ste snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim zhing / yang sngar bzhin 'khor/ sngags 'phreng ni/ rgyun ma la kha dog sngon po 'od dkar po 'phro ba/ sngags gcig gi mjug la gcig gi mgo gtad nas/ mda'i shugs kyi 'jug pa zhes bya/ bsnyen pa'i tshe/ sngags sngon po 'od dmar po 'phro bas lha dbang du bsdud pa/ sngags snga ma'i mjug lcags kyu ltar gug pa la phyi ma'i mgo yang de lta bu'i sbrel ba lcags sgrog 'gros zhes bya/ gnyis ka la sngags 'phreng phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od 'phros nas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal btab/ nang du 'jug pa'i dus bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas rang la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam/ bzlas 'phreng ni/ a bhi dha na las/ lag g.yon mthe bong srin mdzub kyis/ /dung chen 'phreng ba rab blangs nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'phreng ba rab mi'i thod pa'i 'phreng ba'am/ yang na nā ri ke la zhes pa mi mo'i thod pa ste/ be ta'i 'phreng ba lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyi steng du de nyid kyi mthe bong ches 'gugs pa'i tshul du bzlas la/ sngags bzla rgyu ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang / rang rang gi mtshan sngags gnyis med du spel ba/ 'khor lo gsum la yab yum gnyis med/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yab kyi rkang brgyad dang /

mtshan sngags gnyis med/ go cha gnyis rnams so/ /de yang rgyun du gtso bo'i snying po nye snying gang mos gtso bor mang ba/ gzhan rnams kyang cha tshang re bzlas/ bsnyen pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po nye snying la 'bum phrag bzhi re/ 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha khri phrag bzhi re/ go cha gnyis rab gtso bo dang grangs mnyam/ tha na'ang 'khor rnams dang mnyam par bzlas/ sngags dngos ni logs su bris pa ltar dag par 'don no/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba na 'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas brtan byed kyi yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba gong bzhin la/ gtso bo yab yum mi bsdu bar/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po/ sogs/ dpa' bo'i go cha dang / dpa' mo'i go cha/ gong bzhin dang / go cha chen po ni/ pu dza/ sogs nas/ ma ku'i bar ngag tu brjod/ sems kyis lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yab yum nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur/ par bsam mo/ /de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa ni/ rang gi srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar haṃ yig 'bar ba/ zhes brjod/ srin lag de nyid sa la bsnun cing / ngag tu/ haṃ haṃ haṃ zhes brjod pas sa g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thugs khar bsnams pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes smra bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas de'i mchod pa la dmigs te/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang / oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du sngags gzhan 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi/ rol chen dang bcas pa byed/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs gong ltar las/ dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ ces brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar bris shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam la/ oṃ pri thi bi de bi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+ya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

zhes chu gnyis phul la/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas sa la reg ste/ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha sta gon du gnas pa ni/ sa'i lha mo'i sgos mchod dang / me tog dman pa gsal la/ thog mar phur bu btab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du gong du bshams pa'i phur bu 'dus byas la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dbus kyi phur bu blang ste/ ngag tu/ dbus kyi phur bu gnod mdzes nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnams pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ra dza badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang / oṃ gha gha nas/ a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod la/ rang ngam las kyi rdo rjes dbus su gdab gha ta'i sngags kyis gdab par nag po bshad sbyar gsungs pas ma chad pa gal che'o/ /bshad sbyar gyi mjug na gzhung 'di shes par 'dod na 'di med thabs mi 'dug go gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul byas la shar gyi phur gdan la btsugs/ shar lho'i phur bu blangs te/ shar lho'i phur bu mi g.yo ba nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ka ni tu ni badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭ ces dang / gha gha sogs brjod cing shar lho'i phur gdan la btsugs/ lho nub kyi phur bu blangs te/ lho nub kyi phur bu dbyug sngon can sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug pa sngon po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ni la daṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭ dang / gha gha sogs brjod cing lho nub kyi phur gdan la btsugs/

nub byang gi phur bu blangs te/ nub byang gi phur bu rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakraḥrak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ dang gha gha sogs brjod cing nub byang gi phur gdan la btsugs/ byang shar gyi phur bu blangs te/ byang shar gyi phur bu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnams pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ dang gha gha sogs brjod cing byang shar gyi phur gdan la btsugs/ 'dir khro bo lnga la ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod sogs byed pa'i zin bris 'dra dgug na/ rtog bzo mkhas khyad kha thal kho nar shes par bya'o/ de nas dbus kyi phur bu la/ oṃ sum+bha rā dza/ lan lngar brjod de/ dang pos rang ngam las kyi rdo rjes tsan+dan gyi lde gu dbul ba ste/ dri bzang gi chus las kyi rdo rjes ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyi dri bzang gi chu cung zad gtor/ byug pa'i tshul bya/ gnyis pas me tog gi tshom bu dbul las kyi rdo rjes phur gdan gyi mdun du nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu re thog ma nas bkod la sngags brjod dus bsam pas chog gsum pas dar dmar gyi cod pan mgul du bcings/ bzhi pas yungs kar gyi phur ma re mgul du gdags/ phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir cod pan dang yungs kar gyi phur ma phur pa la thog ma nas gdags la sngags brjod dus bsam pas chog lnga pas gu gul gyi dud pas dbul/ las kyi rdo rjes bdug de bzhin du phur bu gzhan rnams la'ang / rang rang gi sngags tshar lnga lnga bzlas te/ tsan+dan gyi lde gu dbul ba sogs shes par bya'o/ rdzas 'di rnams la gzhan gyi rgyas skabs nas puṣ+pe la sogs pa'i sngags so sor brjod pa'i phyag len byed pa dang /

yi ger bris mthong na yang / 'di rje btsun gyi dgongs pa dang 'gal te nag po dkyil chog las de dag thams cad la rang rang gi sngags kyi de dag nyid kyi phur pa'i rtsa bar tsan+dan dmar po'i lde gu dbul ba sogs nas/ re re la'ang rang gi sngags bzla zhing bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lha sta gon gyis maṇ+ḍal rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i dra ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me 'di ni sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pa tshar gsum re sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa nas 'khor gyi gnas thams cad du ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod la/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu+u dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gi dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la reg te/ pu dza u a/

go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su/ na si ma ku/ zhes brjod pas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa rang bzhin gyis lhun gyis grub par gyur/ ces brjod/ tshom bu'i 'god sngags/ oṃ shrī sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni/ sogs kyi gtso bo yab yum dang / 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags dang / thod pa bzhi dang / dur khrod brgyad la 'bru gsum re bzlas shing 'god par bsam/ de nas tshom 'di la dngos gzhi'i dus su dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du zer/ bu dbus ma'i steng du/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i 'phreng ba lta bu'i/ a ā/ sogs/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i 'phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga sogs/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mdun bskyed la aṃ las gri gug mi byed pa ni nag po dkyil chog dang bshad sbyar du ma bshad pas lags/ gis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo lha sum cu rtsa bdun/ thod pa bzhi dang bcas par gyur pa gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bo yab yum dang / bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i tshul dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i nang du glang po che dang / ce spyang dang / mi dang / ba glang rnams 'dzin pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wam̐ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs/ pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ byang rtsibs dza len+dha rar/ mahā kaṅka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub rtsibs au ḍi ya nar kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste gnas/ shar lho'i rtsibs go da ba rir su ra bī ri dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ lho nub kyi rtsibs ra me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang gi rtsibs de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par aṅgu ri dang / ai ra ba ti/ byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / shar lho'i rtsibs ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wi/ lho nub kyi rtsibs lam+pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste ts+tshan+do hā/

nub byang gi rtsibs kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste nye ba'i tshan+do ha ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro ha ste 'du ba/ nub rtsibs saur raṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi ni/ lho rtsibs su bar+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ shar lho'i rtsibs na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub kyi rtsibs sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ nub byang gi rtsibs ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyis kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/

rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang / zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud cing / gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wam̐ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ drag mo shin tu khros pa'i tshul can/ nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ yab rnams kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po/ sogs go cha gnyis dang / ye ye shes pa spyan drangs phyi dang yid byung gi mchod pa tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar byas la bstim/ shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab dbang lha spyan drangs phyi nang yid byung gi mchod pa sgrub thabs kyi tshogs zhing dang 'dra/ rnams sgrub thabs bzhin 'di zin bris kha cig tu mchod yul khyad par ba spyan 'dren bshad kyang 'di ni dgos med yin te/ lha dang bla ma tha dad kho nar bzung ba'i skyon lags/ bya'o/ /de nas sngags mchod ni/ lha so so la dmigs nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re sha ya1/ mahā kalpāg+ni sin+na bhā ya2/

dza ṭā ma ku ṭaṭ+ko ṭā ya3/ daṃṣ+ṭa ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya4/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya5/ pa ra shu pā shwa d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+waṅga dhā ri ṇe6/ byā gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya7/ mahā dhumabran+dha kā ra ba pu ṣā 8ye/ ka ra gnyis/ ku ru gnyis/ ban+ta gnyis/ trā sa ya gnyis/ k+ṣo bha ya gnyis/ hrauṃ gnyis/ hraḥganyis/ phai ཾgnyis/ phaṭ gnyis/ da ha gnyis/ pa tsa gnyis/ bhak+ṣa gnyis/ ba sa ru dhi ran+d+ra/ mā lā ba lim+bi ni/ gṛh+ṇa gnyis/ sap+ta pā ta la/ ga ta bhu dzaṅga/ sar+paṃ ba/ tardza ya gnyis/ a kar+dha gnyis/ hrim gnyis/ dz+nauṃ gnyis/ k+ṣ+maṃ gnyis/ haṃ gnyis/ hīṃ gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li gnyis/ si li gnyis/ hi li gnyis/ dhi li gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa yab kyi rtsa sngags dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā rā1 hī/ ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya ma te mahā/ bi d+ye shwa2 ri/ sarba bhu ta/ bha yā bā he/ mahā 3badz+re/ badz+ra a pa ne/ a dzi te/ a pa rā dzi te/ wa sh+yaṅka ri/ ne tra/ bh+ra ma4 ṇi/ bi ṣa/ sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni/ ka rā li 5ni/ san+t+ra sa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ su pra bhe da6 ni/ pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+ba ni/ stam+bha ni/ mo ha7 ni/ badz+ra wā rā hi/ mahā yo gi ni/ kā me shwo ri kha8 ge tad+ya thā/ prat+gong gnyis/ ha na gnyis/ prā ṇāṃ/ kiṅka ni/ khiṅkhi ni/ dhu na gnyis/ badz+ra hap+te/ ṣo sho ṣa ya gnyis/ kha ṭ+wāṅga/ ka pā la dhā ri ṇi/ mahā pi shi ta/ mān+sā sha ni/ ma nu ṣān+ta/ prā bi te/ sin+na dh+ya/ na rashi ra/ mā la gran+thi ta/ dhā ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bhe/ ha na gnyis/ prā ṇāṃ/ sarba pā pa/ sa twa naṃ/ sarba pa shu nāṃ/ mahā mān+sa/ ts+tshe da ni/ kro dha/ mur+t+te/ daṃṣ+ṭa/ ka rā li ni/ mahā mu tre/ shrī he ru ka de ba s+yā/ gra ma hi ṣi/ sa ha sra/ shi re/ sa ha sra/ bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra na ni/ dz+wa li ta tre dza se/ dz+wā lā mu khi/ siṅga la lo tsa ni/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra a sa ne/ mi li gnyis/ ti mi li gnyis/ he gnyis/ ha gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐/

kha gnyis/ dhū gnyis/ dhu ru gnyis/ mu ru gnyis/ a dwai te/ mahā yo gi ni/ pa thi ta sidhe/ draṃ dhaṃ gnyis/ graṃ gnyis/ he gnyis/ ha gnyis/ bhī me/ ha sa gnyis/ bī re/ hā gnyis/ ho gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lokya bi ṣa nā sha sha ni/ sha ta sa ha sra/ ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta/ pa ri wā ri te hūm̐ phaṭ/ singha ru pe kha/ ga dza ru pe ga trai lokya do re/ sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bī rā dwai te hūm̐ hūm̐/ hā gnyis/ mahā pa shu/ mo hā ni/ yo gi shwa ri twaṃ/ ḍā ki nī/ sarba lo kā nāṃ/ ban+da ni sa d+yaḥ pa t+ya ya kā ri ṇi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhu ta trā sa ni/ mahā bī ri pa ra ma sid+dhe/ yo gi shwo ri phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa yum gyi rtsa sngags dang / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+ba raṃ swāhā/ ces pa yab kyi snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes yum gyis snying po dang / oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa yab kyi nye snying dang / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra b.raṇ+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa yum gyi nye snying dang / oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ1/ oṃ ku ru ku ru tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ2/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha pra bhā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ3/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya mahā nā se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ4/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya bi ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ5/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ khar+b+ba ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ6/ oṃ hraḥhraḥlaṅke shwa ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ7/ oṃ phai ཾphai ཾdru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ8/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ ai ra ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ9/ oṃ da ha da ha mahā bhai ra bī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ10/

oṃ pa tsa pa tsa wā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ11/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi ne su ra bhak+ṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ12/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pa tā lā ga ta bhu dzaṅga sar+pam+bā tardza ya tardza ya sh+ya ma de bī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ13/ oṃ ā kaḍha a kaḍha su bha tre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ14/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ha ya kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ15/ oṃ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ kha gā ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ16/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ17/ oṃ haṃ haṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ18/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ shauṇ+ḍi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ19/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsakra warmi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ20/ oṃ ki li ki li su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ21/ oṃ si li si li mahā bā le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ22/ oṃ hi li hi li tsakra brti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ23/ oṃ dhi li dhi li mahā bīr+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ24/ ces thugs gsungs sku'i lha tshogs dang / oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ū lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa na s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dā d+dhi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma du tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang / oṃ ha na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bo ṣaṭa he hūm̐ hūm̐ ho phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces pas go cha gnyis te/ sngags 'di rnams tshar gcig brjod pas sngags mchod dang / de nas phyi'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/
