oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang po sprul nas/ lha thams cad la mchod pa phul bar bsam la/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakrā sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rje༞ oṃ sarba༞ sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bi ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes zhabs bsil dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs dang / badz+ra puṣ+pe/ zhes pas me tog dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba sogs dang / badz+ra dhu pe zhes pas bdug spos dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas snang gsal ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba sogs dang / badz+ra ā lo ke zhes pas mar me dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ/ zhes pas dri chab dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ zhes pas zhal zas dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ badz+ra shap+da pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas rol mo ste/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i rol chen dang bcas pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'bul ba ste/

phyi mchod do/ /na bza'i mchod pa ni/ rten kheb la sogs pa'i gos zung la/ rdo rje'i rtses bdud rtsi gtor/ oṃ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ lha re re la zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra gos zung 'di nas bzung ste nang mchod gong gi reg bya dbul ba'i bar mi bsdu/ baṣ+ṭa ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la lha re re la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs phul bar bsam/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams sku mdog rgyan cha lugs so so'i mchod rdzas rnams thogs pa spros te/ dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam la/ spro ba'i sngags dngos ni/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ zhes brjod/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi waṃ sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā ra bī ni 'di la sgra snyan sgyur tshul gyi phyag rgya byed/ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la mchod par bsams/ de bzhin du/ oṃ waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ gser zangs mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ga ba dzi ni hūm̐ āḥ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang mṛ taṃ 'di la rnga tho logs nas brdungs tshul byed/

ga badz+ri ni badz+ra pu rtsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ murdzi badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yi mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang murdzi 'di la rnga steng nas rdung tshul byed/ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā sogs dang ha s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ la s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'i༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang la s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ girti badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'i༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang girti badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nirti badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang nirti badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhu paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ in+d+ra ni la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang dhu paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i 'phreng bas mchod/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang dī paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ sin+dhu'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byugs pas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ru pa badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang rū pa badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang rā sa badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ par+ṣ+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ 'di la yang gos zung lag par blangs la 'bul tshul byed/ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang par+ṣ+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dha tu badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang dhar+m+ma dha tu badz+ri ni 'di la nor bu mig gsum pa'i phyag rgya byed/ badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul te/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'o/ /rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las rin po che sna bdun rim pa bzhin du byung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bsam ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra tsakra rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa༞ nor bu rin chen༞ bkren cing 'phongs pa༞ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang ma ṇi rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang bāsti rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang mahā sti rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal te/ /bla med theg pa rab bgrod nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang hasti rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang tu raṅga a shwa rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyan grags mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang khaṅga rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul ba ste/ rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa'o/ /'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa ji snyed yod pa rnams/ bsdu na dngos su bsham pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa'i gzugs la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par rnams kyis mchod par mos te/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/

/bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang rū pa kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshim byed sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang shap+da kā ma gu ṇ+ye badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan+da sbrul snying dang / /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang gan+dhe ka mā gu ṇ+ye badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pas/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang ra sa kā ma gu ṇ+ye badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang par+ṣe kā ma gu ṇ+ye badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa'o/ /nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la 'bru gsum brjod cing / g.yon du lan gsum bskor la dbus nas blang ste gtor bas rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pas mchod par bsam zhing / rang gis bde mchog gi dbang bskur gang la thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par mos la/ ngag tu/ 'dir yang bdud rtsi byin rlabs mdzad nas ha ho hriḥgasum gyi rjes su 'bru gsum brjod la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod de/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes pas thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / de nas he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan slon dpon sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub ri khrod mgon po dang / /lū hi pa dang dha ri ka /rdo rje dril bu rus sbal zhabs/ /'bar 'dzin kar+ṇa gu h+ya pa/ /rnam rgyal zhabs dang ti lo pa/ /nā ro pa dang pham thing pa/ /shes rab brtsegs dang blo gros grags/ /rje btsun kun dga' snying po mchod/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /dkon mchog dpal dang bsod nams dpal/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan pa/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan kun dga'i mtshan/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bla ma mchod/ /lnga rig paṇa chen grags pa'i mtshan/ /mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas mchod/ /dkon mchog blo gros bud+dha'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams mtshan/ /sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan/ /mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rab mchod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na yab yum gyi snying po nye snying / 'khor rnams kyi sngags 'phreng ltar ram bsdu na/ hūm̐/ baṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ pu dza/ ū a/ go ra/ de ma/ ka o/ tri/ ko ka la/ ka hi/ pre/ gṛ/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku/ hūm̐/ brgyad dang go cha gnyis kyi mthar/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa bsdus pa 'di nyid ni don tshang zhing phyag len la'ang 'di mdzad do/ /gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /ces pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams/

spyi gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i thig le bya ste/ 'bru gsum brjod pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wī ye/ dhar+m+mā pa la tsa turmu kha/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+kha si/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsams la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing / zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o/ /mnyes mchod ni/ rang gi lce thog tu bdud rtsi bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas yi ge bdun pa phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyis gsungs shing mnyes par bsams la/ ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa rang gis lan lnga brjod/ lag pas rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang / 'khyud rgya snying khar bya'o/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gsang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ mchod pa'i sprin phung byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bus nam mkha'i khams gang bar mchod par bsams te/ ngag tu/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / zhes pa nas/ na tsa swāhā'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad gtor ma'i skabs bzhin bya/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog la bstod pa 'di yang bya ste/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing / /raṃ raṃ rnam 'khor ut+pal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi/ /rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan/ /tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan can/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pa/ /mi yi seṅge dregs pa 'joms mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing / /a la la yi sgra sgrog bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad/ /cang te'u'i sgra sgrog lha chen khyab 'jug stag gi pags pa bsnams/ /thugs rje cher sprul rab 'phros dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing / /lak+ṣ+miṃ go ri zhabs kyis gnon cing ku tsar rab tu bzhugs/ /lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can/ /lha rnams kun gyi 'khor gyi 'khor los yongs bskor mdzad pa po/ /hū ya hū ya dziṃ dziṃ traṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyi/ /'phreng ba 'dzin zhing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khros pa yis/

/klu sgra mi zad hū lu hū lu rab tu rmongs mdzad cing / /rdo rje chen po ma mā kis ni sku lus rnam par brgyan/ /dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyi 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad/ /ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgras gnod sbyin tshogs rnams skrag rengs mdzad/ /brkyangs bskums tshul gyis bzhugs shing bi bi sha nas sku lus brgyan/ /bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni/ /ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭ kyis mdzad pa can/ /stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro/ /phyin ci log zhen lta ngan mtha' dag ma lus sel mdzad cing / /gu lu gu lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ gyis ni zhi bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin/ /bde ba chen po khyod ni maṃ maṃ zhes ni mdzad pa can/ /sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa po/ /ā li kā li rab tu sbyor ba'i sdom pa gsang ba can/ /bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yi/ /dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di bsgom phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ ku sha'i mchod pa ni/ ku sha rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa'i chun po brgyad 'dus byas la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed 'di/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing / las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/

oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥzhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs g.yon skor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du dbul bar bya'o/ /kha sbyor brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ dngos su kha sbyor brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dam/ de ma yin pa'i gnas gzhan du'ang rung ste mchod pa byas na rab/ de ma 'byor na ting nge 'dzin gyi phyogs brgyad du kha sbyor brgyad bsam la/ lus kyis 'khyud pa'i stangs ka lan brgyad byas te/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mnyes par bsams mo/ /de ltar mchod pas mchod nas/ snyan gsan dbab spos 'bul ba'i tshul dang med pa rnams rdo rje thugs khar thal mo gyen bstan gyi tshul du bzung la tshigs bcad re la dril sil bya/ pa'i phyir bdud rtsi ril bu cung zad bsres pa'i spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu thogs la/ dbyangs dang ldan pa'am med kyang rung ste/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig ma'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag bdag gis ni/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nas dbang blang bar 'tshal na sa 'dir byon nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces brjod cing gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas slob ma sta gon don tshan bcu bzhis bsdus pa ni dkyil chog tu blta'o/

/bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ rgyas par na bum pa zhe drug la sogs pa mang bar gsungs kyang / mdor bsdu na rnam rgyal dang / las thams cad pa'i bum pa gnyis su mdzad de/ de gnyis la'ang mtshan rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang / las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa gdags so/ ma btags pa la sogs pa tshul bzhin du bsham pa/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis gdan 'khor lo rim pa lnga dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sogs nas sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ thod pa bzhi khaṇ+ḍa ro hī dang bcas pa rnams su gyur pa ni rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sogs nas/ nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso 'khor thams cad lha sta gon bzhin la/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor mi zer ba/ shar du kha gdong ma sogs brjod/ las thams cad pa'i bum par khaṇ+ḍa ro hī sku mdog nag po dkyil chog las las thams cad pa'i bum par bde chen 'khor lo 'am khaṇ+ḍa ro ha bsgom gsungs pas na khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'i sku mdog dmar skya dang dmar ser ni sgrub thabs gang byed pa bzhin dgos so/ /dmar skya g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon mi dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/

skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis dbu la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa nag po dkyil chog dang bshad sbyar gnyis su ma gsungs pas mi dgos so/ /brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa rnams kyis gsal btab cing bskyed/ go cha bgo ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams sta gon bzhin la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hī la 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pa rī wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ nas gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i bar gyi rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ pu dza/ nas ma ku'i bar dang / hūm̐ brgyad dang go cha gnyis brjod pa'i mthar/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis khaṇ+ḍa ro hī dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod/ oṃ hrīḥ 'bru gsum brjod la bdud rtsi myang ste/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi lce la myang / lag pas rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'khyud rgya byas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas mnyes mchod/ na mo chos kyi sogs kyis yid mchod/ sna tshogs rol mo dang bcas pas rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ de nas pad bskor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blang ste/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas lha so so la phog pas dmar lam lam song ba dang / sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun phra la la byung bas bum pa thams cad mer mer gang bar gyur/ ces brjod la/ rnam rgyal la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs yum gyi nye snying kho sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyang rnam rgyal du bskyed pas sngags zur du mi dgos/ na dang / las bum la sum+bha ni dang /

khrus kyi don du a bhi ṣe ka ta rnams brgya rtsa re bzlas la/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyi mthar ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang / bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces dang / pad skor sngon 'gros dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul tshul ni/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su baṃ las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+ruṃ me long lta bu'i༞ byang du khaṃ bya ba sgrub༞ nub tu dz+riṃ so sor rtogs pa༞ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dbus su byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po rtse mo 'og tu bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og tu song bas rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du bskyod pas/

steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭ+waṃ ga rnams las bdud rtsi 'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭ+waṃ ga rnams kyang 'od du zhu/ gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ gtor mgron ni/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel na bdag bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad dang mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ de'i dur khrod brgyad dang / gnyis ka dang ma 'brel ba zur du 'bul na/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo yab yum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros dur khrod brgyad la phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo cha brgyad du gyur/ yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor thams cad phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor cha dgur gyur/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ/ tṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā kī nī kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ma kar+ya/ pā dha ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swāhā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ rgyas par na lha sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gcig brjod pas kyang 'bul bar bshad do/ /bsdu na/ ka ra ka ra sogs dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags tshar gcig brjod/

de nas mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi mchod sa bon so so'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ na mo sogs yid mchod/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kalpāg+ni sin+na bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭorka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṣ+ṭaṃ kā ra lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā sra rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bya gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā dhum brān+dha kā ra ba pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi'o/ /oṃ na mo bhā ga wa ti badz+ra bā ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te mahā bī d+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mas+sarba bhu ta bhā ya bā h+ye mahā ba dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te bā byaṅka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka rā li ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mas+saṃ trā sa naṃ/ ma ra ṇi/ su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥpa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra hi/ mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri/ kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'o/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa 'joms/ /khyed kyis dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje'i char gyis yang dag bslan pa'i thugs kyi chus/ /lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gong du bshad pa ltar gyi mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma 'bul tshul de nyid kyis phul la/ de nas yi dam chos skyong sogs gzhan 'bul dgos rnams gtor chog so so nas 'byung ba ltar skabs dang sbyar la dbul/

sta gon gyi rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ nas gan+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ nas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ oṃ 'dir yang 'bru gsum brjod la bdud rtsi myang ste/ hrīḥha ha sogs 'khyud rgya dang / a nu rā ga sogs kyis mnyes mchod/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs sngags dang bcas pas yid mchod/ rol mo dang bcas pas rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ yi ge brgya pa gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas lhag chad kha bskangs shing bzod par gsol/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun nas lag gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur snying khar bsnol la/ hūm̐ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang gi sna bug gnyis nas zhugs te snying kha'i gnas su thim par gyur/ de nas rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang / badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ oṃ ha dkar po/

sogs/ dpa' bo'i go cha/ dang / dpa' mo'i go cha gong bzhin dang / go cha chen po ni/ pu dza sogs nas/ ma ku'i bar ngag tu brjod 'tshams sam sngags kyis bsrungs ba ni gong bsrung 'khor skabs bzhin/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur ston cing / ngag tu/ oṃ sum+bha sogs tshar gnyis brjod dus sems kyis phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar ser 'bar ba'o/ /steng 'og g.yon g.yas bsnol mar bya/ dag pa gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku'i rnam pa/ yi ge bdun pa tshar gcig brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung gi rang bzhin hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags 'dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang sngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs tshang ma dang / gzhan yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes bya'o/ /sta gon thams cad bstan zin to// //dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa gsum pa thig gi bri ba la gnyis las/ dang po las thig gi cha dbye ba ni gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi mdun du thig tshon rnams 'dus byas la rdo rje'i rtses dbus su sngon po la hūm̐/

shar du dkar po la bh+ruṃ/ lhor ser po la aṃ/ nub tu dmar po la dz+rīṃ/ byang du ljang khu la khaṃ rnams bris pa'i/ tshon so so'i nang du kha dog dang mthun pa'i srad bu'ang bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma gcig dang / nang mchod rnams bshams nas/ rang lha'i nga rgyal du gnas pas thig tshon rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po bh+ruṃ las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ser mo aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser mo rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po dz+rīṃ las 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang gu khaṃ las don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du sogs yab kyi go cha bgo rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bstim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ nas shap+da pra tīts+tsha swāhās mchod/ gtor ma sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /'khor ba stong bar mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/

/rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ho/ zhes dang yum gyi nye snying / sarba bud+dha sogs dang / rtsa sngags gnyis med rnams ci rigs brjod cing / bla ma'i mtheb srin gyis rdul tshon mnyes la/ thig tshon gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam/ tshon gtso bo lnga po de nas mtheb srin gyis so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon gzhan rnams la'ang cung zad re blug par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma mkha' 'gro ma'am/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hir bsams la thig skud rnams so sor brkyangs la bsgril bar bya ste/ yum gyi nye snying lan mang du bzlas/ rtsa sngags gnyis su med pa yang bzlas shing thig skud rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril zin pa dang / rdo rje la dkris la bdud rtsi gtor zhing byin gyis brlabs/ ye thig gdab pa dngos ni dkyil chog bzhin gdab dgos pas/ de nas ji ltar gdab pa'i thabs ni/ bla mas rnal 'byor pa'i shar te 'jig rten pa'i lhor bsdad la/ slob ma rnal 'byor pa'i nub ste 'jig rten pa'i byang du gnas pa la/ dzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod de thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥbarjod cing blangs la bla mas thig skud kyi dkyil nas lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ steng nas gcus te blangs la 'og nas yar la btab pas thig skud kyi sgra las/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can gyi don mdzod cig ces 'byung ba yang bsam/ ngag tu yang brjod la bar snang la thig rjes bsam mo/ /ye thig bskor phyogs rtogs sla ba'i phyir sdom du byas na/ lho byang nub shar rgyab 'gros kyis/ /tshangs thig gnyis ni gdab bya zhing / /me rlung srin dbang rgyab 'gros kyis/ /zur thig gnyis ni gdab par bya/ /me dbang me srin shar dang lho/ /rlung srin rlung dbang nub dang byang / /rgyab 'gros spangs te g.yon phyogs su/

/bskor bas thig rjes g.yas skor 'byung / /nyis sdeb dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ /bla ma dbang ldan mi 'gro zhing / /slob ma me yi mtshams mi 'gro /phyogs mtshams ngos 'dzin 'jig rten dang / /mthun par ye thig 'khrul med gdab/ /ces pa ltar shes par byas la/ slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo 'jig rten pa'i lho dang / slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi nub ste 'jig rten pa'i byang du gnas pa'i thig skud slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la dkri'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma ho/ zhes brjod cing ye thig nam mkhar bteg la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin nas shar sgor bltas la/ gar bskor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thugs kha dang / dril bu dkur bzung la smin ma gcus te dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi la bltas la/ hi hi zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi phye bar bsam/ srin lag gnyis kyi dri bzang gi chus sgo bzhis rtsa thig dbye la/ ngag tu/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa rnams dbyi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ thig gi bri ba rnams bstan zin to// //dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bzhi pa tshon gyi bri ba ni/ gzhi tshon ser po ste ngo bo la sngon por yong yang kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir ser po byas na mdzes gsungs kyang lcags nag shin tu nag pas gzhi tshon byas pa legs shing kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon mi yong bas dgongs pa 'grub pa yin no/ /bla mas dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bri ba'i dus su yang 'di skad du/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni grol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsams/ /zhes brjod cing bri bar bya'o/

/de nas yid kyis mchod pa lnga phul la/ ting la sogs pas kha bcad de rdo rje la ye shes kyi thig skud dkris pas steng nas mnan la phyis de'i mtshams su sleb sleb tu kha mi dbye bar bzhag phur khung tshon gyis dgang ba ni/ nang gi 'og tu dkar po/ de nas ser po/ de nas dmar po/ de nas ljang khu/ de nas sngon pos dgang de nas dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis dri tshul rgyas pa kho bos logs su bkod pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /ngo / /de ltar bris zin pa dang / thig tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod pa mdor bsdus phul la/ ye shes pa rnams sta gon gyi lha'i thugs rang gi snying kha na bzhugs pa'i/ khar thim/ zhes dang / nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa'o/ /de nas rgyan dgram pa'i thog ma bum pa dbul ba ni/ spos dang rol mo sngon du 'gro bas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa dang / las kyi rdo rjes las bum bzung la/ dkyil 'khor la g.yon phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas te yig brgya brjod/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lha rnams la bum pa 'bul ba'i tshul byas la/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la shar sgo'i g.yon phyogs su bum gdan gyi steng du bzhag yang slob dpon gyis las bum bzung la/ sum+bha ni bzla zhing lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas pa'i mthar/ khaṇ+ḍa ro has dkyil 'khor gyis bya ba mthar ma phyin gyis bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la shar sgo'i g.yas phyogs su bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog la sogs pa'i spyi mchod dang / sgos mchod ni ji tsam 'byor pa ci mdzes su bkod/ gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod la sogs pa dang gos zung ku sha'i chun po brgyad/

ting lo/ chang bu gtor ma rnams gsum gsum/ til/ gu gul/ me long / sku phyis/ yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma sogs phyag len bzhin bshams/ slob ma dbang bskur dgos na de'i yo byad dkyil chog bzhin ma tshang ba med par 'dus byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas gnas yo byin rlabs gnyis sta gon bzhin la/ brtsams ste/ bdag gtso 'khor thams cad la/ bskyed rigs bdag rgyas 'debs yan sgrub thabs bzhin la/ mchod nag po dkyil chog las bdag nyid la tshes bcu'i dus bzhin mchod pa ci 'grub bya gsungs ba bzhin 'di tsam cis kyang ma chad pa gal che/ pa'i skabs su sngags mchod dang / phyi mchod kyi rjes su rig ma bcu drug rin chen sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams tshigs bcad dor la sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ de'i rjes su nang mchod nas brtsams te go cha gsum gyi bsrung ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ sngar phur pa rnams bsdud zin bris la lar phur bu bsdu ba'i dus mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la sogs bshad pa ni brtsam ran ma nas nyes par gda' bas rje btsun gyi dgongs pa bzhin mdzad na mi dgos so/ /dgos byung na skabs 'dir sta gon bzhin phur gdab tshul bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sbyang ba'i chas rnams dkyil 'khor dang nye bar phyag len bzhin bsham ste/ gtor ma gsum chab kyis bran la las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su gtor ma bskor ba dang bstun te/ dpon slob rnams kyi lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sogs brjod/ sngags rdzogs pa dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byed/ zhi ba'i sbyang ba dang / de bzhin du ting lo dang / chang bus bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje gsor/ sum+bha ni brjod pa lan gsum byas zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba dang / la/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te bsgrub cing mchod pa dang /

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa sogs slob ma yod na slob ma 'jug cing sogs skabs dang sbyar ro/ /la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos sum+bha ni bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brab bo/ drag po'i sbyang ba la khro bo'i spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs gzhan nas rgyas mi 'gebs/ 'di tsam gyis don tshang zhing nag po dkyil chog gi dgongs pa'ang 'grub bo/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni las kyi rdo rjes g.yas phyogs su me dang g.yon du chu de gnyis kyi bar du til bzhag la/ ngag tu/ bdag gi snying kha nas tshe thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig pa rnams yi ge kaṃ gi rnam par byung nas/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ ces dang las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb srin gyis til blangs la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod la til de nyid g.yas su mer bsreg g.yon du chur blug la de nas me de yang g.yon gyi chur blug la phyir dor ro/ /khrus kyi don du las kyi rdo rjes las bum me long / sku phyis rnams bzung la/ dpon slob rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod cing me long la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor bri mkhan gyi mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad bkru'o/ /de nas/ de dag sku la sogs dang / 'di ni bdag la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dam pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi phyag len ltar bkod pa yin/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥka ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes brjod cing sku phyi tshul bya'o/ /nag po dkyil chog tu sku phyi ba'i tshig ma bshad kyang / mkha' 'gro lnga'i sa bon brjod cing me long la dri'i thig le lnga byed pa gsungs par ni/ sku phyis la sa bon lnga'am/ 'dir slob dpon rang nyid kyi gdong bkru bar bshad pa dang ma bshad pa mang du snang yang / phyag len la mi mdzad 'dug pa ni/ nag po bshad sbyar du gdong ni dag par bkru bar bya/ /zhes bya bas sgrub pa po bdag rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ zhes gsungs pas dkyil chog gi sdig pa sbyangs skabs/ bdag dang slob ma gnyis kyi sdig pa sbyangs zhes til gyi sbyang pas don tshang bar snang ngo / /dri'i thig le lnga byed par gong du byed pas/ don 'dra bar snang zhing / de dag sku la sogs tshig kyang dgos par thon no/ /sbyangs khrus rnams dngos gzhi byung tshad la byed dgos/ bri ba dang rgyan dgram pa bstan zin to// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa lnga pa bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa la/ dang po bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor swā bhā was sbyangs/ bsang ba ni bgegs sbyang ba rgyas pa sogs ma dag yin pas/ sum+bha ni sogs bsdus pa'i bsang ba mi dgos so/ /stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa'i bar sta gon gyi skabs su ji skad bshad pa ltar las khyad par tshom bu'i 'god sngags dor la sgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed na/

dngos gzhi nyi ma dang po la/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i sngon du sngar gyi khu tshur bsnol ba'i phyag rgya mdun du brkyangs te/ hūm̐ rang gi snying kha nas sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ ces brjod/ de rnams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs yid mchod kyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /lha rnams byin gyis brlabs pa drug skor la las kyi rdo rjes rdo rje'i dbyug pa gzungs thag btags la bzung ste lha gang byin gyis rlob pa'i gnas der rdo rje'i rtse mos reg cing slob dpon gyis de'i gzungs thag nas bzung ba'am/ yang na slob dpon nyid kyis phyag gi rdo rjes lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa bdun thod pa bzhi rnams la phyogs g.yon skor mtshams g.yas skor gyis reg ste/ dang po rang sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa la/ gtso bo yab yum la snying po gnyis ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs dang / oṃ bai ro tsa ni sogs brjod/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ oṃ ḍā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs spel med pa rang sngags rkyang pa brjod/ thod pa bzhi la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bzhi/ thugs 'khor rnams la/ oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇ+ṭe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs dang / gsung 'khor ba rnams la/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ e ra ba ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs dang / sku 'khor ba rnams la/ oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs rang sngags rkyang pa brjod/ gnyis pa oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs yum gyi nye snying dang / gsum pa kā kā s+ye sogs nas su ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces pa'i bar sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang / bzhi pa/ oṃ a ā nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i ā li dang / lnga pa/ oṃ ka kha ga gha nga nas sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces kā li dang / drug pa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs nas brtan par byas la/ mthar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i dgos pa ni/ dang pos chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du shes pa'i phyir lha rang sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pas lha so so'i rnam pa de yang chos sku skye ba med pa'i rnam 'phrul du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir yum gyi nye snying gis byin gyis rlabs/ gsum pas chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i don du sgo ma bzhis sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ bzhi pas 'phrin las bzhi po de yang thabs snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba dgos pa'i ched du ā lis byin gyis brlabs/ lnga pas thabs snying rje chen po de yang shes rab kyi zin pa cig dgos zhes mtshon pa'i phyir kā lis byin gyis brlabs/ drug pas ni de thams cad brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /de dag gis ni bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa bstan zin to// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa drug pa mchod pa ni/ sngags mchod nas brtsams te kha sbyor brgyad kyi mchod pa'i bar sta gon bzhin bya ba ste mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs kyang phyag len la bdag 'jug gi rjes la mdzad do/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel nas byed na/ dngos gzhi dang po la bum bskyed sta gon gyi dgongs sgrub zin pas mi dgos/ gnyis pa man chad la skabs 'dir bum bskyed mdzad//

//de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun pa 'jug pa la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang / slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa la'ang phyi'i 'jug pa dang nang 'jug gnyis kyi dang po la bdun las/ dang po yon dbul ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ bum pa/ dbu rgyan/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod tsam ma gtogs gzhan dbang rdzas rnams yid kyis/ de nas las bum gyi chus gdong bkru ba'am/ cung zad cig 'thung la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul dus/ dang po dang / tha ma la tshig rgyas pa brjod cing / gzhan rnams la maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba 'debs pa nag po dkyil chog nas ma bshad pas mi mdzad do/ /sogs kyis dbul/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ ces brjod/ gnyis pa bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ nas/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /sogs dkyil chog bzhin lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa gdong bcing ba ni/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / gdong dar bcings tshul dang / bzhi pa me tog 'phreng ba gtad pa ni/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ me tog nas 'bras gang rung lag tu blang / ku shas las bum gyi chu rang la gtor zhing / mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hī dpag tu med pa spros te/ bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ lnga pa dri zhing lan gdab pa ni/

bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa'i lan gdab par mos la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pa lan gcig brjod/ dkyil chog las dri ba lan gsum gsungs kyang phyag len la tshar gcig mdzad do// //drug pa nang gi sems bskyed pa ni snying khar rdo rje bzung la/ rang gi snying gi nang du rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa shin tu 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa gsang bar gdams shing nang du gzhug pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ lag gnyis thal mo'i bar du rdo rje bzung dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo dud pa dang bcas pas ngag tu/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pa de tsam gyis ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o// //gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa la bcu bzhi'i nag po bshad sbyar gyi dgongs pa ltar lags/ dang po dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas gsung bar bsam la/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni gzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa lhar bskyed cing go cha bcing ba la thog mar nang gi bar chad bsrung ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang / bdud rtsi lcer myang zhing lus la'ang gtor/ lhar bskyed cing go cha bcing ba dngos ni/ rang skad cig gis pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du sogs go cha gnyis dgod/

gsum pa dpa' bo bskul ba ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor te/ ngag tu/ phai ཾrang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas rang la gnyis su med par thim/ ces brjod/ rang gi mthe bong g.yas pa gtso bo'i phyag g.yon pas bzung phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dkrol bar bsam la/ ḍā ma ru dkrol/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a bad+me bi d+ya rā dza a dhi ma he swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing / rang gi sems nyid la dpa' bo bskul bar bsam pa'o/ /bzhi pa phyag dang skyabs 'gro gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag la 'grub par mdzod/ kyis bar sbrel te lan gsum dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ lnga pa sbyang ba bya ba ni/ gong bzhin sbyang ba gsum byed/ de tsam mi nus na bgegs phyag len la bdag 'jug gi tshe bgegs sbyang ba las mi mdzad/ sbyang ba tsam byas kyang rung ngo // //drug pa nang du 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi lhar bskyed pa ni/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ zhes pa 'di hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug dkar po mi gsung ba hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa gsung ba phyag len yin/

nas/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed kyang rung / rang gi snying khar rtsa 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi hūm̐ yig bcom ldan 'das nang gi he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sogs gtso bo yab yum dang / nang skor rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir mdun nas brtsams te g.yon bskor du laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ las shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ sogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad las shar du khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed/ zhal phyag rnams sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /phyi nang gi lha de rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas yab yum rnams kyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis go cha gnyis dgod/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang / phai ཾsnying kha'i gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs kyi rang bzhin/ yi ge ā l̥ kā l̥'i rnam par spyan drangs rang gi snying khar thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad khyab ste zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de tsam gyis lha dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa'o/ /bdun pa phyag bya ba ni/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥme hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes dang / spros pa la dga' na/ sgo bzhi nas phyag bya ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas mkha' 'gro mas bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la ngag tu/

oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi ni pu dzo sas+d+ya na ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya tā ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni at+ma ḍā ki ṇī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ de nas byang sgo nas lā mas bdag la dbang skur cig snyam pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pu dzo a bhi ṣe ka ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni at+ma lā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ nub sgor khaṇ+ḍa ro has chos kyi 'khor lo skor cig snyam pa'i thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ ngag tu/ oṃ pu dzo dhar+m+mā tsakra pra brta ya na ma at+ma nas at+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dhar+m+mā tsakra pra brta na ya maṃ/ lho sgor gzugs can mas 'phrin las mdzod cig snyam pa'i thal mo spyi gtsug tu sbyar la/ ngag tu/ oṃ nas pu dzo karmā ne at+ma nas at+ma ru bi ni karmā ku ru maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ brgyad pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ 'di'i lugs kyis sdom pa bsgrags pa tsam gyis kyang thob par bzhed pas thog mar bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa 'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems dang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyed kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba 'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/

/ces tshar gcig brjod/ de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sras bcas kye rdor gzhi'i cho ga sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sogs lan gsum 'di'i rjes la khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la sogs mdzad pa'i 'phags pa sogs kyi zin bris 'dug kyang nag po dkyil chog dang bshad sbyar gnyis kar ma bshad 'dug pas re zhig brtag par bya'o/ /brjod/ dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'i bar gyis phan yon gyi sgo nas dang / yang rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /sogs nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang / bdud rtsi blud de/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ sogs brjod cing bdud rtsi 'thung ba gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ sogs kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/

/bcu pa nang gi 'jug pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul kha bskangs nas mdzad/ te/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ bcu gcig pa ye shes pa dbab cing brtan par bya ba ni/ rang 'khor phyag len la gzhung gong 'og cung zad bsgyur ba 'di bzhin mdzod/ lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu re re/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ mgrin par waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po waṃ dang 'byung bzhi bskyed pa nag po dkyil chog rnams mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug na'ang / nged rang sa lo'i sgrub thabs nyams su len mkhan rnams ngag 'don bde ba dang ha cang 'gal ba mi 'dug pas sgrub thabs bzhin bris pa lags/ bum pas mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la has mtshan pa/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ phul/ des sum mdo'i me sbar/ des snying kha'i sa bsros/ des mgrin pa'i chu skol/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun snying kha'i sa la thim pas lus la bde drod dpag tu med pa skyes/ de'i dus su rkang mthil gyi rlung dang mes nam mkha' la bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis mar 'phul bas lus bar snang la 'dar yed yed gnas pa la nam mkha' nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de yang lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams dkar po'i rnam pas thim zhing /

de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba spu'i bu ga nas thim par bsam zhing / rol mo dang rdzas kyis bdug cing / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / oṃ bai ro tsa nī/ sogs yab yum gyi snying po gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha a be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a bit+ma he bi d+ya rā dza a dhi ma he swāhā/ zhes brjod bdag 'jug la spog chog mi mdzad/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag cing brtan par bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba bdag 'jug la dngos su mi mdzad/ bcu gsum pa me tog dor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum cu rtsa bdun la gtso bo dang 'khor la sogs pa'i bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ma byed cig thams cad kyang dag pa'i ye shes gcig gi snang ba yin la/ rang gi rigs dang rjes su mthun pa la me tog phog pa yin no/ /zhes bgo bar bsams nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+rahoḥ zhes brjod la ltos med du dor bar bsam/ me tog bcings pa ni/ rang gis me tog phul ba de gtso bo bla mas slar blangs te/ rang gi mgo bor bcings par bsams la/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /sogs brjod/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun khyod dbang bskur 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /sogs dang / sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs/

/gnyis med gnyis med spo na gnas/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol ba rab stsol ba/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /zhes pa'i bar sbrel te lan gcig brjod la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de tsam gyis ni slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni dkyil chog tu blta'o/ / 'di'i ngag 'don mtshams sbyor sngags 'chang chen pos logs su mdzad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun pa bstan zin to// //de nas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /ces pa lan gsum gyis gsol dpa' bo chen po sogs 'dir mi mdzad/ ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi skur gyur/ ces brjod yungs kar gyis brdeg cing / sum+bha ni bzlas/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod/ sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog dor ro// //spyi don gsum pa brtul zhugs kyi rim pa la bcu bzhir gnas pa las/ dang po me tog 'phreng ba'i sngags kyis dbang 'dir oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes brjod pa'i zin bris 'ga' zhig snang mod/

phyag len la mi mdzad de/ nag po bshad sbyar na/ ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu la phul bar bsam mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /don gyi bzlas lung yin la 'jug pa'i dus kyi me tog dbul ba lta bu ni ma yin no/ /zin bris pa rnams ni sngar gang la phog pa'i lha la phul gsungs pa la 'khrul par zad do/ /'di don nag po bshad sbyar la zhib tu gzigs pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags gyi 'phreng ba byung zhal nas thon te/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / oṃ bai ro tsa ni sogs gsum gsum bzlas me tog dor te/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshar gcig brjod/ slar me tog de nyid sngags kyi 'phreng bar bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag par bsam ste/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs bar bsam zhing brjod/ rigs lnga yab yum du byed pa ni/ nag po bshad sbyar du/ slob ma gnyis med sbyor ldan zhes bya ba ni/ chu'i dbang la sogs pa'i bye brag gis/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa yab yum gyi lha'i nga rgyal 'dzin du 'jug pa'o/ /'dis ni he ru ka yab yum du slob ma bskyed pa gsal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ nag po dkyil chog tu mi gsal ba rnams bshad sbyar du gsal bar mdzad pa yin pas/ rje btsun gyi dgongs pa'ang rigs lnga yum can yin par sems so/ /de na cho ga'i rnam gzhag ni 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gnyis pa mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par bzhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ ces dang / rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar phai ཾbadz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ bar bsam zhing / bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ kā kā s+ye/ ū lu ka s+ye/ shwa na s+ye/ sū ka rā s+ye/ ya mā dā ḍhi ye/ ya ma dū tī ye/ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭī ṇ+ye/ ya ma ma tha nī ye/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob par gyur/ ces brjod cing bum chu khyor bar blugs te 'thung / bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ bsam pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ ces nang gi dbang ngo /

/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang ni/ oṃ swā bhā wa dang / bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te/ nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra de'i pang du yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur ces dang / khyed rnams kyis sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gis brgyan pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbang skur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha/ sogs yum gyi nye snying dang / oṃ pra tīts+tsha mahā mu ku ṭa hoḥ zhes brjod cing dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcing / kā kā sogs sngags rnams gong bzhin brjod la ku sha'i rtsa bas bum chu spyi bor gtor la chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas thim pas/ lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ ces nang gi dbang ngo /

/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang ni/ swa bhā wa dang bdag gi 'dus shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te/ /sogs dang / dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi 'dus shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ ces dang / khyed rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje longs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin/ gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'od dpag med dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba nas zhugs pas lus thams cad 'od dpag tu med pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ ces nang gi dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/

'od dpag tu med pa dang skal ba mnyam pa byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ swā bhā wa dang / bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/ sogs dang / khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag rdzas kyis/ dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas ral gri dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ ces dang / khyed rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed/ /ces brjod la dril bu lag pa g.yon par sbyin/ gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis don yod grub pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas thim pas lus thams cad don yod grub pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ ces nang gi dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang skal ba mnyam pa byas pa yin no/ /drug pa rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ni/ swā bhā wa dang / bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te/ sogs dang / bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas 'khor lo dang /

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ khyed rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ shrī he ru ka na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ dpal che rang rang gi gsang mtshan brjod/ ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing thugs kha nas spros pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis ming 'dogs par bsam pa'o/ /de nas gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rnam par snang mdzad dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ mgo thur bltas bsgom pa'i bu kha nas thim pas lus thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes nang dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /bdun pa brtul zhugs la gnyis las/ dang po rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir thun mong gi brtul zhugs ni swa bhā wa dang / rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang skad cig gis mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na sogs mi bskyod pa chu dbang bzhin byed/ rang gi thugs kar yang mi bskyod pa de 'dra ba gcig gi rgyas btab par gyur/ zhes nang dbang gi dod yin no/ /de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/

/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs la gnas par gyis shig ces brjod la lag tu rdo rje gtad pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /gnyis pa spyod pa la nus pa mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ swa bhā wa dang / rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i snying khar yang bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyis rgyas btab par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yas par ḍā ma ru/ g.yon par thod pa/ bse ral khar tshangs skud/ g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga byin par bsams la/ 'di la g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin tshul byed/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na de ltar shes par gyis la/ sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod pa ste rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ngo / /brgyad pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas/ sogs nas/ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyi bar brjod/ rdo rje gsor nas mthar snying khar bzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /rdo rje 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ rig stong dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa yang rig stong dbyer med pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ni/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces brjod/ dril bu dkrol la mthar dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam par byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba grag stong dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ rang gi ngag rnam par dag pa yang grag stong dbyer med pa'i dril bu'i sgra ltar shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ ces brjod/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas te/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /rang nyid lha'i sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa gsal la ma 'gags pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ gong bzhin ku sha'i rtsa bas dngos su bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ ngag tu/ oṃ kā kā s+ye/ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan pa la/ lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ su tra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang brgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni rjes gzung phyir/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /zhes dang / deng phyin chad khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ dkyil 'khor 'di tshigs bcad kyi gong du bshad kyang phyag len la gong 'og cung zad bsgyur te mdzad pa yin no/ /dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las thams cad bsgrub par gyis shig ces bsgo bar bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod pa ste rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo /

/dgu pa rjes gnang ni/ thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i phyir nang gi lha mo brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i tshul du bya ba ste/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang / /shes rab thams cad snyems can gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ /a/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /'phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyi blangs bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /ghi/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur ba gyis/ /ho/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yis/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bh+ruṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /āḥ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis/ /pra/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /gha/ zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ de ltar na khyed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi drung du sgeg pa la sogs pa'i spyod pas dkyil 'khor la mchod pas/ deng phyin chad de lta bu'i spyod pa ci byas pa thams cad lha mchod par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ gser gyi thur ma'am/ rdo rjes mig gi thad sor byug pa'i tshul du bya zhing /
