ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ zhes brjod/ me long la bltar bcug par bsam ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med gyis/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ gong du bshad kyang 'dir mdzad/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis la/ sems can thams cad la don gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo/ lag pa g.yas par dung g.yon par dril bu/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar du rgyud kyi po ti sbyin par bsam la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten du ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyis 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ 'dir nag po bshad sbyar las/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /nas/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes pa'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa kyai rdor bzhin dang / de ltar na sems can la chos kyi 'khor lo/ nas/ sgra sgrogs bshad pa gyis shig ces spyi ltar brjod/ de nas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/

/ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lam de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de dag gi ni rjes gnang ngo // //bcu pa dam tshig ni/ thog mar dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ste/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /bsrung dang sa la sogs pa yis/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med la gnas pa/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mang po'i tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan mar 'gom par mi bya 'o/ /dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ni ma khyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung / /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/

/zhes pa'i bar brjod la don dran par bya'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs 'dir mi mdzad pa dbang bzhi rdzogs nas mdzad pa phyag len no/ /spyod pa dang thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag gnas la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa/ /dam tshig spyad na spyod pa yin/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /'gro ba med pa'i rgyun bcad pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung / /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun la ni rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis med sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dgar ba ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsam nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /zhes brjod la don dran par bya'o/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos de kho na nyid la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ bde ba chen pos thig le la chags pa ste/ chags pa 'di bzhi dang bral ba las khams gsum na sdig che ba med pas/ khyod kyis de dag dang bral bar mi bya zhing de dag la bslab par byos shig /ces brjod// //bcu gcig pa lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ bla mas chos gos gyon la g.yon pas chos gos kyi mtha' snying khar bzung / g.yas rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin rang gi spyi bor gtugs par bsams la/

he ru ka dpal g.yas rdor dril lhan cig dang g.yon rdul gzan sogs la seṅge'i rna ba ltar bzos la/ lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ston/ /ces brjod pa'i mthar/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su he badz+ra aṃ gu ri shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston pa mdzad do/ /zhes brjod/ de ni ma 'ongs pa lung ston pa dang / da ltar ba dga' ba bskyed pa ni gzengs bstod pa'o// //bcu gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa na/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang de bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod la don yang dran par bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te sogs 'dir mi mdzad/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil dpe bris kyi sogs skabs dang sbyar/ 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrungs ba dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'di kha skong / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod do// //bcu gsum pa gsang ba ni/

thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes pas gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdong / 'og tu bshad kyang 'dir mdzad/ bcing tshul bya/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ā las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze'u 'bru la ā dang / bu khar dh+yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ dang / bu khar byāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi dpral bar oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya/ nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis/ bar brjod pa yab kyi rtsa sngags/ yab kyi dpral bar oṃ na mo bhā ga wa ti badz+ra bā rā hi nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā'i bar brjod pa yum gyi rtsa sngags/ yum gyi mgrin par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / yab kyi mgrin par oṃ badz+ra bai ro sogs snying po gnyis dang / yum gyi snying khar oṃ hriḥha ha sogs dang / yab kyi snying khar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ sogs nye snying gnyis brjod/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags rnams sbrul 'khyil ba ltar g.yon skor du 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ bla ma he ru 'di yang sgrigs 'don mdzad/ ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' bas sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba de nyid rang 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i lce thog tu bzhag ces brjod cing bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor/ /khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag mgrin par myangs nas yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags rim 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol bar bsam ste 'bru gsum brjod/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon skyon med btab pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang / lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod// //bcu bzhi pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba gsol ba gdab/ gdong 'dir mdzad/ bcing ba rnams gsang dbang bzhin byas la/ de nas bla ma'i thugs kha nas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig sprul te rang gi lag pa g.yas par phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yon pa gtad/ bla ma nyid kyi phyag rang gi mgo bor bzhag par bsams te/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zungs shig zungs shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor/

/khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rtag sbyor bas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs tha ma dag spyod cing / /pad+ma'i bha gar tsum+ba dang / /bdud rtsi rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun/ /gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang / /gnyis med tshul gyi tsum+bha na/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam/ /smros shig dpa' bo bde ba che/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am/ /ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed pa nus/ /zhes dri ba dris lan rnams don dran bzhin pas brjod la/ rang dang phyag rgya 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha'/ sogs nas/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pas/ thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba la sogs pa'i chos drug nyams su blangs pas rnam pa sna tshogs pa la dga' ba'i ye shes/ tsum+bha dang 'khyud pa la sogs pas rnam par smin pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ bo la dang kak+ko la sbyar bas rnam par nyed pa la dga' bral gyis dga' ba'i ye shes/ srub cing srub pa'i sbyor ba la brten nas mtshan nyid dang bral ba la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsams la cung zad mnyam par gzhag de ltar rdo rje dang pad+ma cher bsrubs pas/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad nas so so'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis g.yos te/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug par byang sems dkar po dang /

yum gyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor byang sems dmar po byon pa gnyis zhal sbyar bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis byang sems dkar dmar gnyis phyir ba thag pa tsam yang ma 'dzag par byas la/ yar drangs nas so so'i lte bar sleb pas dga' ba/ snying khar sleb pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par sleb pas dga' bral/ spyi bor sleb pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de ltar na lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab ste/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par gzhag go /de nas 'bru gsum brjod gdong g.yogs bkrol bar bsam mo/ /de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag dpe myu gu sngon po skyes pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa dang / lam dngos dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /brtul zhugs kyi rim pa bcu bzhi po kun bstan zin to// //de nas dbang bzhi pa bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya ba tshig tsam gyis bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong bcings tshul bya/ de nas ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes brjod la/ de'i don ni/ khyod kyis dbang gsum pa'i dus su phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pas rnam rtog thams cad 'gag cing / sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ngo bor shar ba de ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin la/

des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes zung du 'jug pa de nyid/ dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi byed pa po ni rang gi sems yin/ sems kyi mtshan nyid kyang kun rdzob tu gsal zhing rig pa tsam de nyid/ phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i mthus/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bor snang ba yin la/ don dam par rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ de nyams su len par byed pa la rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba la sogs pa lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pas ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs te rang nyid lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa sgyu ma'i sku dang / sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ros gang ba dang / de dag gi ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /yang 'bru gsum brjod la gdong phye/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid kyi dri ma dag dpe 'bras bu yongs su smin pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya'o snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / dbang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun no/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma sta gon bzhin phul la/ slob ma dbang bskur dgos na dkyil chog tu blta'o// 'di'i ngag 'don mtshams sbyor sngags 'chang chen pos logs na mdzad pa ltar ro// //spyi don bzhi pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/

chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul/ de nas hūm̐ baṃ la sogs pas nang mchod/ mnyes mchod/ yid mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs gong bzhin brjod/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel te byed na/ nub dang po rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod cing me tog dor/ gzhan brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol spyi dang 'dra/ de nas go cha gsum dgod/ mtsham rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ smon lam bkra shis sogs byed/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i nyin bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi khyams kyi steng du spyan drangs la mchod bstod yan gong bzhin bya/ phur pa rnams bsdus te gnas dben par bskyal/ de la mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs gsol sogs gong ma'i yig cha na med pas mi dgos/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su langs te yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar/ bla ma yi dam sogs kyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ me tog gtor nas brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi lha/ gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs tshar gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams sna bug gnyis nas rang la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por bshig la/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa yid la dran pas/ ngag tu/ a kā ro'i sngags brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi me ris nas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i mtshan ma nas spyi bor bzhag bar rdo rje'i rtses ri mo 'then/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan rnams la'ang 'then/ gzhan sgrub g.yog pa kha cig gis rdul tshon mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus te/ rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du blug thig rjes rnams dri bzang gi chus phyag len la bum chu slob dpon gyis blug sgrub g.yog pas thig rjes med par bsub bo/ /phyis la rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas rang la go cha gsum dang / tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba dga' ba gsum dran pa smon lam dang bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/

/rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs/ /pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug 'phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /byang chub sems dang tsan+dan dri chen gur gum chus/ /gang ba'i snod bzhis dpa' bo'i zhal la reg par spyod/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i gnas la legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i 'phreng / /gnas la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i 'phreng / /'du la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su/ /khwa gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang / /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gu mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang / /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni rab tu brgyan par gyur pa yis/ /mu tig dra ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs/ /ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar zhing / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig yongs su bskor ba'i dur khrod brgyad rnams su/ /phyogs skyong brgyad dang shing chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas pa la/ /gdong gnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni nye bar gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab tu 'bar gyur cing / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus gyur cing / /dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad 'bab cing / /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang / /sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyis nye bar brten pa yi/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur/ /rdo rje'i bla bres kun nas bres shing mda' yi dra bar ldan/ /ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ces dang / gzhan yang chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas pa brjod/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ dkyil 'khor bris shul la me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// //sgrub thabs kyi rjes kyi rnal 'byor gyi nang tshan spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la lnga ste/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyid log pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba rang yab yum la bsdu/ yum yang yab la bsdu/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ de zhabs kyu khog pa la bsdu/ de mgo bo la bsdu/ de zla tshes la bsdu/ de thig le la bsdu/ de nā da la bsdu/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/

/gnyis pa ldang ba na/ nam mkha'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra ka ra ka ra la sogs pa dang / yi ge bdun pa'i sgrar grags pas bslangs te/ skad cig gis he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rdzogs par lang ngo / /de'i thugs kha'i 'od kyis snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar dran par byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha/ sogs brjod cing don dran par bya'o// //gsum pa khrus byed pa'i tshe nam mkhar dbang lha sngar bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i chus rang gi lus la blugs pas sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag dag par bsam zhing / yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bkru'o/ /bzhi pa kha zas ni gtor ma ltar byin rlabs byed pa'am bsdu na lag pa g.yon pas kha zas btung ba sogs la reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur pa rang he ru ka'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar bas lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs gsal btab pa'am/ nang gi gtso bo he ru ka'i spyi bor bla ma rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa dang / lte bar chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam zhing longs spyod do/ /lhag ma/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ /lnga pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzhan la 'jug pa'i tshe/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ tsham rngam sngags kyi srung ba'i nang du bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / de yang rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug tu shes pa'i ngang nas chos kyi bshad nyan gtor ma chos spyod kha ton la sogs pa dge ba'i bya ba kho na la rtag 'grus su byas na/ myur du shrī he ru ka'i go 'phang 'grub par 'gyur ro// //de ltar grub chen nag po spyod pa yis/ /legs par bkral ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi /sgrub dkyil sa lo chen po yab sras kyis/ /mdzad pa lhan cig bsdebs pa'i bstan chos 'di/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/

/gsar bu'i blo can 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bsdebs 'di la/ /rjes 'jug blo gsal gzhon nu skal bzang rnams/ /snyom las ma byed thos bsam mthar phyin gyis/ /cho ga'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang / /zhib par slobs la rang gzhan don gnyis sgrubs/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan/ /rigs rus phun tshogs rnam dpyod spyan yangs pa/ /mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /dus 'khor rtsis gzhung rgya mtshor mkhas de 'o/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma kun kyang mkha' spyod gnas 'dzoms te/ /phan tshun ngo shes bsam sbyor mthun gyur nas/ /rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing / /mang bgrod rang gi spangs rtogs mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /bstan chos 'di nyid 'dzin dang sems pa dang / /nyams su len pa'i skal bzang de rnams la/ /bsrung zhing skyong dang chos 'di cher 'phel ba/ /u rgyan gyi yul gyi/ nor bdag zhing skyong yab yum khyed kyis mdzod/ /dharme u dā ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig /gcig zhus dag/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sa lo chen po sogs kyi bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub dkyil gnyis lhan cig bsdebs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
